sources.title: BAAI/bge-small-en · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: New reranker model: release cross-encoder models BAAI/bge-reranker-base and BAAI/bge-reranker-large, which are more powerful than embedding model. We recommend to use/fine-tune them to re-rank top-k documents returned by embedding models.

sources.title: GitHub - linxinhong/bge-small
sources.snippet: 模型： BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5 （约 24M 参数，ONNX int8 量化 ~23MB） 向量：512 维，L2 归一化（点积即余弦相似度） 推理：ONNX Runtime CPU，CLS pooling，最长 512 token（超长自动截断） 接口：兼容 OpenAI /v1/embeddings 风格

sources.snippet: Welcome to the ONNX Model Zoo! The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is an open standard format created to represent machine learning models.
